== Course of events ==

After the Tin Woodman felled a tree to bridge a second, wider ditch and cut away its end to send two pursuing Kalidahs crashing into the ravine below, and after the Lion had already carried each companion across an earlier ditch on his back, the group's path was blocked once more, this time leaving the Scarecrow stranded and unable to cross under his own power. A Stork agreed to rescue him, lifting the Scarecrow by the arms and carrying him back to the rest of the group.

With the Scarecrow safely returned to his companions, the group was able to press onward together. The Lion ran ahead of the others but collapsed asleep just short of the edge of a field of poppies, and it was afterward, while crossing that field, that the poppies' scent overpowered Dorothy, Toto, and the Lion, putting them to sleep, while the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman, unaffected by the scent, remained conscious and able to help their companions.
